primary_question: Does a second declared local filter reduce currently admitted coefficient candidates before rational arithmetic without losing known positives or projective cases?
prime_rule: Smallest odd prime greater than197 with distinct first three shifts modulo that prime; decide good reduction before viewing candidate survival.
coefficient_pool: Lexicographic triples(m,n,r) in[-4,4]^3 satisfying the recorded mod51 gate. Generate at most first40 distinct new X values after exact duplicate/prior-fixture removal; never count duplicates as new evidence.
positive_controls: All four original class1 columns, infinity as a necessary allowed state, exact finite partial lift Q=2P2+P4-P3.
negative_controls: replace strict fixed-factor rejection with equality rejection
remove q<=1e6 from overflow safety conclusion
treat quotient point as full lift
assume known rational generators are complete
comparison: Count second-prime rejection among first-prime survivors; measure rational evaluations avoided and exact certificate checking work. State sample and duplicate counts, not a general probability.
secondary_scope: Only if time remains, bind exact gap/factor predicates to frozen toy and known-grid inputs with independent consumer. Do not rerun historical denominator scan.
renewal: Renew only for new evidence or a materially different informative test. A passed filter is not a column. No new column still permits a useful certified search-adapter result; no discrimination demands a pivot or HOLD.
